probes.message: No-change is selected as the main forecast. ARIMA/SARIMAX/ETS/Theta failures are empirical findings, not a paper-finalization blocker when the baseline wins honestly.
probes.threshold: no-change rows exist and pass the pre-registered rolling backtest; advanced model failures are recorded but non-blocking

probes.message: E1 weekend event has been remapped to the first common trading day. Single-window conventional significance is blocked; formal evidence uses recursive normal-return CAR and matched placebo p-values.
probes.threshold: E1 maps to 2026-03-02; stage dummy is descriptive only; CAR[0], CAR[0,+1], CAR[0,+2] carry formal event inference

probes.message: Matched weekend placebo evidence uses the add-one correction, so a finite pseudo-event sample cannot report an empirical p-value of exactly zero.
probes.threshold: matched weekend placebo distribution exists and finite-sample corrected empirical p-values lie in (0, 1]

probes.message: The event-path gap is labeled as ARBaselineGap rather than a war premium or causal no-war contribution.
probes.threshold: descriptive AR baseline field exists and old causal premium field is absent

probes.message: Reduced-form oil returns do not substitute for full structural coverage. Q2/Q3 structural interpretation remains conditional until the three structural shock series cover enough history.
probes.threshold: supply, aggregate-demand and oil-specific-risk shocks each have at least 120 nonmissing monthly observations

probes.message: Q2/Q3 use structural shock columns when available and retain reduced-form OilShock only as robustness. Current EIA STEO decomposition is too short for full-history structural claims.
probes.threshold: Q1 exports supply, aggregate-demand and oil-specific-risk shocks for Q2/Q3; each core structural shock has at least 120 months

probes.message: Q2 remains conditional until official IAV and PPI histories enter the processed layer; no interpolation is used to fill the gap.
probes.threshold: NBS IAV and PPI monthly histories are present with enough observations

probes.message: Q2 output distinguishes structural shock categories from reduced-form robustness and blocks unsupported growth-loss wording.
probes.threshold: LP inference flags, structural-shock labels and conclusion guardrails are present

probes.message: Q3 remains conditional until China has enough official regulated fuel-price history to enter the main fuel ranking with the six control countries.
probes.threshold: China official observed/regulated fuel series enters the main comparison and at least six control countries remain comparable

probes.message: Q3 has a policy-buffer interaction interface. Current fuel and industrial-activity interactions may be unidentifiable until China fuel/IAV data are official and comparable.
probes.threshold: Panel LP reports Shock×Buffer interactions with country FE and full year-month FE

probes.message: Policy scenario fields distinguish incremental and cumulative gaps, matching the revised chart annotation.
probes.threshold: April annotation separates incremental 380 from cumulative 1425 CNY/tonne

probes.message: The policy scenario must be computed on the official regulated finished-fuel price layer, while macro propagation may remain conditional when coverage is short.
probes.threshold: China policy counterfactual is based on official regulated finished-fuel price layer, not Brent-CNY proxy arithmetic

probes.message: Figure axes and legends are localized to Chinese; large titles are not painted into the figure canvas.
probes.threshold: eight figure PNGs exist, visible labels are localized, and large titles are left to LaTeX captions

probes.message: Raw-source provenance cannot claim a cache exists unless the file is present and hashable. REMOTE_ONLY records keep missing browser/official snapshots visible.
probes.threshold: source_manifest has no CACHED/DOWNLOADED rows whose local snapshot is absent

probes.message: The replay target is pinned independently of the interpreter used only to package and verify artifacts.
probes.threshold: Python 3.11.9 and exact dependency lock are recorded

probes.message: The reproducibility manifest records model outputs, processed inputs and model code so raw snapshots that cannot be redistributed do not prevent reproducibility checks and later code edits invalidate stale freezes.
probes.threshold: all core result files, processed model inputs and model code files are hashed
